basics.name: Artem
basics.title: Senior QA Lead
basics.summary:
Senior QA Engineer with 10+ years of experience in software quality assurance and cross-platform testing (macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android).

Experienced in leading QA teams, mentoring junior testers, and implementing structured testing processes to improve product quality and delivery speed. Strong expertise in regression, usability, and exploratory testing, supported by solid knowledge of test planning and documentation.

Passionate about building reliable software and optimizing QA workflows. Actively developing mobile automation frameworks using Python and Appium, with a current focus on bridging the gap to autonomous testing using AI-driven solutions, computer vision, and Vision LLMs.

highlights: Comprehensive quality assurance for a modern web application, ensuring seamless frontend and backend performance.
Design and execute extensive API testing workflows using Postman to validate RESTful endpoints and data integrity.
Develop and maintain scalable automated UI and API test suites utilizing JavaScript-based automation frameworks.
Perform backend database validation and execute complex queries using SQL to ensure data consistency across environments.
Performed comprehensive manual testing of mobile and desktop applications.
Created detailed test documentation, improving traceability and bug reporting efficiency.
Collaborated with developers to resolve critical issues before release, reducing hotfix needs.
Coordinated QA activities and mentored junior testers.
Established structured test processes, improving defect detection rate by 25%.
Drove continuous improvements in test strategy aligned with Agile methodology.
Tested desktop and mobile applications for Mac OS X, iOS, and Android.
Performed smoke, functional, regression, exploratory, and GUI testing.
Developed test reports and trackers, enhancing project visibility for stakeholders.
Maintained IT infrastructure and supported staff with technical issues.
Taught computer science and developed educational programs for students.
